selection.nativeFocus: Chromium public CDP disables forced focus emulation for actual background tabs. WebKit driver forces active/focus; its matrices explicitly exclude only new native-tab/BFCache cases and retain visibility accounting/navigation/Continue. Prior selections retained by contract.

retainedFailures.resolution: Guard synchronous status publication against reentrant clock eligibility changes.
Publish meaningful saved-status transitions while keeping routine clock checkpoints quiet.
Disable Chromium forced-focus emulation; actual tab switching now passes, no synthetic blur claimed.
Retain review pause continuously between saving and confirmation; WebKit native focus unsupported by public driver.
Exact lifecycle byte assertion now checkpoints legitimate elapsed time; asynchronous reset waits for new identity. Focused 6-case repair and fresh handoffs passed. Original batch remains failed.
Confirmed replacement retains existing modal pause until old scene stops; fresh held-enemy proof passed.
New witness waits for acknowledged new identity before polling history; final 4/4 passed.
Normal flushed navigation gets real native BFCache; unflushed programmatic hard departure may reload instead. Saved replacement bytes survive. No guarantee of BFCache on every departure.

limitations: Closed/hidden/blurred/paused time is excluded; abrupt termination can lose the final bounded checkpoint interval.
Counter-only v1 saves preserve known kills/moves while timeCoverage is since-upgrade; legacy stats and earlier unproven duration bests cannot be reconstructed.
Native browser BFCache admission is best effort; normal-link cached restoration and safe reload fallback are separately witnessed.
Automatic approval review rejected cleanup of the temporary detached comparison worktree; it remains intact.
